notes.title: Update - 2022-09-26
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have just released an update for Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure which corrects the following issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed rare crash when casting a certain skill while confused.
[*] Fixed crash on start when using certain keyboard hardware with controller-like functions.
[/list]
